India's Parliament Monsoon Session Concludes Amid Disruptions and Protests

India's Parliament concluded its Monsoon Session on August 11, 2021, marked by significant disruptions and protests, primarily concerning the NEET exam controversy. The Rajya Sabha was adjourned sine die after a stormy session. Lok Sabha productivity was reported at 19%. Opposition MPs questioned the Home Minister's absence amidst the uproar. Editors debated the session's washout and the breakdown of parliamentary trust.
